literal: erkek kardeş = brother; kardeş alone is gender-neutral sibling

partner (loanword, now standard in this sense): eşim already names the spouse in introductions.this-is-my-husband-wife, and sevgilim skews to boyfriend/girlfriend; partner is neutral about marital status
iş arkadaşım = work friend, distinct from arkadaşım already used for introductions.this-is-my-friend
